integrity: The complete proof uses an exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matching and an exact integral boundary computation; two standalone C++17 checkers and their outputs are included. No independent mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the twenty-vertex graph GP(10,2) and the second independence complex. Does not determine equivariant homotopy, homeomorphism type, or other parameters; publication priority remains provisional.
title: The dodecahedral second independence complex has the homotopy type of \(S^6\)
